entries.title: Hosea 12:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 A reproof of Ephraim, Judah, and Jacob. 3 By former favours he exhorts to repentance. 7 Ephraim's sins provoke God.

feedeth. 8:7; Job 15:2; Jer 22:22 he daily. 11:12 and they. 5:13; 2Ki 15:19; 17:4-6; Isa 30:6,7

entries.title: Hosea 12:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: a controversy. 4:1; Jer 25:31; Mic 6:2 and will. 2Ki 17:19,20; Isa 8:7,8; 10:6; Jer 3:8-11; Eze 23:11-21 Eze 23:31,32 punish. Heb. visit upon. 2:13; 8:13; 9:9; Isa 10:12; 24:21; *marg: according to his doings. Isa 3:11; 59:18; Mt 16:27; Ro 2:6; Ga 6:7

entries.title: Hosea 12:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: took. Ge 25:26; Ro 9:11 had, etc. Heb. was a prince, or, behaved himself princely. Ge 32:24-28; Jas 5:16-18

entries.title: Hosea 12:7

entries.content: a merchant. or, Canaan. Eze 16:3; Zec 14:21; Joh 2:16 the balances. Le 19:35,36; Pr 11:1; 16:11; Am 8:5,6; Mic 6:10,11; 1Ti 6:9,10 he loveth. Isa 3:5; Eze 22:29; Am 2:7; 3:9; 4:1; 5:11; Mic 2:1; 3:1-3; 7:2 Mal 3:5; Jas 5:4 oppress. or, deceive. 1Sa 12:3
